metadata.description: Domain routers that dispatch agent skills to the right specialist.

plugins.name: atelier
plugins.description: Eight domain routers — web-design, video-production, seo, backend, payments, security, vibe-code, ship-it — that each dispatch to their own set of specialist skills. 105 skills in total: 36 ship bundled for offline install, 67 are fetched from public sources, and 2 are excluded as too large.
